Class TextTableDrawer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.table.TextTableDrawer
public class TextTableDrawer extends Object
The TextTableDrawer type draws a TableModel as text. The ASCII style uses +, -, and |. The box style uses Unicode box-drawing characters. Optional SGR sequences color the border, the header, and the body cells. SGR is the select-graphic-rendition sequence that sets terminal color.

  • Method Details

    • draw

      public String draw(TableModel model, FormatContext ctx)
      The draw method paints one table and separates the lines with line feeds. If the model has no columns, the method returns the empty string. The column budget is FormatContext.getColumns(), and a budget below 16 becomes 16. fillWidths(TableModel, int[]) measures the cells, and shrinkWidths(int[], int) reduces the widest columns until the table fits. The style box, ignoring case, selects the Unicode box characters. Any other style selects ASCII. The painted order is a top rule, the header, a middle rule, each data row, and a bottom rule.
      Parameters:
      model - The table to draw.
      ctx - The column budget, the style, and the SGR sequences.
      Returns:
      The drawn table, with a line feed after every rule and every row.

    • fillWidths

      private void fillWidths(TableModel model, int[] widths)
      The fillWidths method stores the widest text length in each column. The header length is the starting width. A data cell that is longer replaces that width. A column whose measured width is below one is stored as one.
      Parameters:
      model - The table being measured.
      widths - The array that receives one width per column.

    • shrinkWidths

      private void shrinkWidths(int[] widths, int budget)
      The shrinkWidths method reduces column widths until the table fits the budget. The chrome cost is one plus three times the column count. The available content width is the budget minus that chrome. If that available width is below the column count, it becomes the column count. While the widths sum to more than the available width, the widest column loses one. If every widest column is already one, the method returns and leaves the overflow.
      Parameters:
      widths - The column widths, changed in place.
      budget - The terminal column count, including borders.

    • rule

      private String rule(int[] widths, boolean box, boolean top, boolean bottom, String sgr, String reset)
      The rule method builds one horizontal rule. If box is true, the line uses Unicode box characters, with a different corner set for the top, the bottom, and a middle rule. If box is false, the line uses + and -. Each column contributes its width plus two dash characters. A joint character is written between columns. The border SGR sequence is written before the rule, and the reset sequence is written after it.
      Parameters:
      widths - The column widths.
      box - true for Unicode box characters, or false for ASCII.
      top - true when this is the top rule.
      bottom - true when this is the bottom rule.
      sgr - The border color sequence.
      reset - The sequence that clears color.
      Returns:
      One rule line, without a trailing line feed.

    • dataRow

      private String dataRow(List<String> cells, int[] widths, boolean box, String cellSgr, String borderSgr, String reset)
      The dataRow method builds one header or data line. If box is true, the vertical bar is the Unicode box bar. If box is false, the vertical bar is |. A missing cell is an empty string. A cell longer than its width is cut to that width. The cell is padded with spaces out to the width, with one space on each side. The border sequence colors each bar, and the cell sequence colors the padded text. The reset sequence is written after each colored span.
      Parameters:
      cells - The row cells.
      widths - The column widths.
      box - true for a Unicode bar, or false for |.
      cellSgr - The color sequence for the cell text.
      borderSgr - The color sequence for the bars.
      reset - The sequence that clears color.
      Returns:
      One data line, without a trailing line feed.
